messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: SURPASS-CVOT randomized 13,299 adults with type 2 diabetes and established cardiovascular disease.
The adults were randomized to Mounjaro (tirzepatide, up to 15 mg once weekly) or dulaglutide 1.5 mg once weekly.
Dulaglutide is a GLP-1 medicine already approved to reduce cardiovascular risk.
The study had a median follow-up of about 4 years.
Cardiovascular death, non-fatal heart attack, or non-fatal stroke occurred in 12.1% of those taking Mounjaro.
These events occurred in 13.0% of those taking dulaglutide.
The hazard ratio was 0.92 with a 95% CI of 0.83–1.01.
The results met the trial's goal of non-inferiority.
The results did not demonstrate superiority.
Death from any cause occurred in 8.5% of the Mounjaro group.
Death from any cause occurred in 10.1% of the dulaglutide group.
The hazard ratio was 0.84 with a 95% confidence interval of 0.75–0.94.
This outcome was not a primary endpoint.
This outcome was not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
Therefore, the result should be read as exploratory.
These results describe how Mounjaro performs against another GLP-1.
Triplet: ["Mounjaro", "had confidence interval", "0.83–1.01"]

The relation 'had confidence interval' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug or outcome had the specified range of confidence interval.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has tested dose': The subject drug was tested at the dose level specified by the object entity.
B. 'has pediatric dose study': The subject drug has been studied in the specified pediatric population or dosage range.
C. 'tested in': The subject drug was evaluated in the clinical trial specified by the object entity.
D. 'has study result': The subject drug is associated with the study result specified by the object entity.
E. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
